dedupe_keys.name: raw rgb line scan images from industrial weee sorting experiments

description: This companion collection preserves raw RGB image streams from an industrial sensor-based machine sorting shredded electrical and electronic waste. The research team acquired the images at Fraunhofer IWKS in Alzenau, Germany, using ferrous and non-ferrous metals, circuit boards and plastics in two particle-size classes. The provider describes recognition, mass-prediction and mixed-sample validation subsets. TUdatalib labels this collection Open Access under CC BY 4.0 and lists large ZIP archives, with several individual parts exceeding thirty gigabytes. Geographic coverage is one pilot sorting plant, and calendar acquisition dates were not established. The raw images underlie the separately released cropped-image and mass collection, so they are not independent experiments. Controlled material mixtures and incomplete verification of the entire archive inventory are limitations. Modellers could examine object extraction and sensor uncertainty before constructing sorting-process simulations; model-odym offers a related flow-accounting tool. No archive or image was downloaded and no image-processing pipeline was run.
name: Raw RGB line-scan images from industrial WEEE sorting experiments
